inspiration.observed_pattern: A staged INSERT ... SELECT assigns new IDs by adding an ordered ROW_NUMBER value to scalar maximums from existing tables.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to one active source table and one target table: an INSERT ... SELECT must evaluate GREATEST/COALESCE scalar maxima and materialize ROW_NUMBER values before storing the generated IDs. The source schema and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Two active source rows receive generated IDs 13 and 14 above the greater of the target maximum 10 and source maximum 12; one inactive row is filtered out.
determinism_notes: Source IDs, labels, active flags, scalar maxima, fixed ordering, and final ordering are fixed; there are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE source_values (source_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label_text VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, active TINYINT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE generated_values (generated_id INT PRIMARY KEY, source_id INT NOT NULL, label_text VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO generated_values (generated_id, source_id, label_text) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY source_id) + GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(generated_id) FROM generated_values), 0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(source_id) FROM source_values), 0)), source_id, label_text FROM source_values WHERE active = 1
SELECT generated_id, source_id, label_text FROM generated_values ORDER BY generated_id

checks.sql: SELECT generated_id, source_id, label_text FROM generated_values ORDER BY generated_id
